data.gender_notes: Iremika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Iremika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ila', which refers to a goddess. The suffix 'mika' is a common feminine suffix. The name Iremika can be interpreted as the abode or residence of the goddess Ila. The name Iremika carries the meaning “Goddess Ila's abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Iremika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess ila's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the divine presence of the goddess Ila, inspiring devotion and faith.
data.etymology: Iremika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Ila's abode.”
